ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% high-intensity white pixels across the central ventral surface, contrasted with 15% low-intensity black pixels localized to the peduncle insertion and trailing margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous black base at the peduncle; scattered dark circular pixel clusters (mottling) across the interior of both lobes; a distinct yellowish-tan pigment patch on the lower-left inner quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 52 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration pattern along the entire length; pixel-amplitude of peaks varies between 3 to 12 pixels against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge of both lobes, terminating in sharp convex distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple dark, roughly circular pixel clusters ranging from 5-15 pixels in diameter, distributed with higher density on the right lobe than the left.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent, irregular, high-contrast textured masses (barnacle colonization) observed on the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized brownish-tan pigmentation region on the lower-left lobe surface, distinct from the primary grayscale intensity map.
